title: Set up a password manager
summary: Configure a team password manager for shared credentials and secure sharing. 1Password Business is the canonical route.

parts.title: Create the password manager business account
parts.guidance: Create the selected business password-manager account with a company-controlled administrator and the agreed subscription. Decide who administers it, who provides backup, and how access is recovered if an administrator is unavailable. Enable the service's supported sign-in protections. Put recovery material in a protected location available to the designated backup administrator, and explain when and how they should use it.

parts.title: Create shared vaults
parts.guidance: Create shared vaults around groups that genuinely need the same credentials, such as finance or infrastructure operations. Give each vault an owner and separate highly sensitive accounts from broadly shared tools. Check whether members can view, edit, export, or share items before placing credentials there. Move each existing shared credential to its intended vault and verify access with the people who use it, leaving personal accounts outside the company vaults.

parts.title: Invite team members
parts.guidance: Invite teammates using their verified company addresses and initial access groups. The administrator should check the recipients and permissions before sending invitations, then provide instructions for sign-in, recovery, and moving work credentials into the correct vault. Follow up on incomplete enrollment. Help each person find and update a credential for one of their authorized work accounts.

parts.title: Configure access groups
parts.guidance: Map each role to the vaults and permissions it needs, keeping administration and the ability to grant further access limited to the responsible people. Apply the group memberships and check sensitive finance and production access with their owners. Document how joining, changing roles, and leaving the company affect membership. Assign temporary access an owner and an agreed removal point.

metadata.supportReason: 1Password has APIs for vault/user management. Account creation is manual. Post-setup management automatable.
